newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted mostly steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted mostly steady to higher.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained quoted mostly steady to higher levels in the nearby positions Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded, the same as Wednesday.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, next week, bid 145 percent of tariff, up five percent from Wednesday, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi, next week, bid 115 percent, up five percentage points from Wednesday, similar, no offer.
